Name: (AT) Moonchild's Wormfarm Wormbins and Baitmaker for Alternative Textures
Author: NorthForestMoon
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Worm farm & bait maker retextures of worm bin, deluxe worm bin, bait maker, and chests for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].  [/color]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52202/52202-1789270432-1792285004.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Includes[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Retextures for:[/color]
[list]
[*]Worm Bin - Worm Farm[/*]
[*]Deluxe Worm Bin - Mossy Worm Farm[/*]
[*]Bait Maker - Earthy/wood/brown Recoloured Bait Maker[/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]All of these textures can also be applied to any chest. [/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Chest[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Big Chest[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stone Chest[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Big Stone Chest[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Junimo Chest[/color][/*]
[/list][quote][color=#D4D4D8][i]I may add more options/palettes if I feel like it or if requested.
Feel free to suggest ideas for bait chest designs...?[/i][/color][/quote][color=#D4D4D8][i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52202/52202-1789241779-452637523.png[/img][/i][/color]

Colour palettes/materials match with my other mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52221](AT) Moonchild's Heat Fire Stuff Things for Alternative Textures[/url]!

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. [/color]
